Early Termination: Compute the accumulated opacity (occlusion) $W(t)$.

For example, using shading from level 2 and occlusion from level 2 ($C_2/W_2$) resulted in an error of -0.027605, while using shading from level 0 and occlusion from level 0 ($C_0/W_0$) resulted in an error of 0.011057.
